regions.merged_text: Friday - Mary Canning - 20 of Jamaica - having left St. Michael's Parish here while. in Hi-School moved with parents to Jamaica .... ... since going to the Jamaica High seems to have lost respect for religion, parents, duties, etc. - refuses to listen to Mother - too old-fashioned. Now absent from Home since Jan. 15th - 22 months. Enrolled To-day in Ser. Masses - Mother promising to read one book of the "Mysticle City" if things brighten inside a week.

regions.merged_text: Raymond Pasko - 5 yrs. old, 18 1bs - here from Detroit, Mich. Seemingly a healthy baby for three days. Then stomach and liver went bad. Measles followed. Ailing ever since with frequent spasms. Last July fever mounted to 106. .... Parents going to Holy Communion twice a year ... Promise to do better.

regions.merged_text: Francis Noris came from Detroit: had been studying medicine for several years - two yrs. more to graduate when recently on coming to passage: "Seek ye first the kingdom of God and His justice" - he decided to show a little gratitude by consecrating himself to God. Seems docile and willing to follow suggestion to be Cap- uchin priest - 27 yrs. of age.
